name: GJH Can — Australia Abalone
summary: A 425g canned australia abalone with a label unrolled from the official Australia SKU packshots.
description: Metre-scale tinplate can with double-seam rims, recessed lid with ring-pull and a wrap-around label textured from the official front and reverse Australia 425g packshots.
author: Yap Wei Jun project / agent-assisted procedural modeling
creation_method: Deterministic Blender Python geometry (tinplate can, seams, lid, ring-pull). Label texture is unrolled from the owner's source-verified official packshots; no logo or text was redrawn or generated.
accuracy_notes: Diameter is a nominal 73.5 mm; height follows the packshot aspect ratio. Not an official packaging specification. The label is a single-view unroll: the strips near each side of the can are blended between the front and reverse photographs, and shading baked into those photographs remains.

attribution.credit: Label artwork unrolled from GJH eShop official packshots recorded in Webpage-Design-Gallery assets/companies/gjh/official (manifest.json). Can geometry is original.

rights: Packaging artwork belongs to its respective owners (GJH / New Moon). Used in the owner's project on the owner's confirmation; no independent licence document was supplied. Public redistribution terms have not been specified.
